narrative:
Operating expenses of NOK 1,010M are planned by cost center and legal entity: personnel NOK 640M, platform & cloud NOK 185M, sales & marketing NOK 120M and G&A NOK 65M.

Four legacy SMSC platforms are still live; each switch-off onto MyLINK CORE removes its run cost (NOK 57M in total).

signals.title: Adjusted EBITDA NOK 680M — 40.2% of GP, gate passed

signals.excerpt: Opex of NOK 1,010M (personnel NOK 640M, platform & cloud NOK 185M). The finance gate passes: within 5% of ambition and above the 38% EBITDA floor. Four legacy SMSC platforms migrate onto MyLINK CORE.
